title: HTB: Voleur
summary: Kerberos-only Active Directory box: enumerate with nxc and rusthound, abuse WriteSPN via bloodyAD to roast a service account, restore a tombstoned user with PowerView, and decrypt DPAPI blobs to reach Domain Admin.

title: HTB: DevHub
summary: An exposed MCPJam Inspector API gives RCE, a leaked Jupyter token pivots to a second user, and a root Flask service leaks the SSH keys for root.
